sources.entry: Gramps - A genealogy program that is both intuitive for hobbyists and feature-complete for professional genealogists.

summary.one_liner: Gramps is a desktop genealogy program aimed at both hobbyist family historians and professional genealogists.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Gramps as a genealogy program intended to be intuitive for hobbyists while remaining feature-complete for professional genealogists. It requires Python 3.10+, GTK 3.24+ and pygobject, plus Cairo, Pango and librsvg bindings, and lists orjson as a required dependency. Optional packages add geographic map views (osmgpsmap), Graphviz-based reports, ICU-based localized sorting, spell checking in notes (gspell), RCS archiving of family trees, and Exif metadata handling (gexiv2). The README also notes third-party addons such as Family Sheet, Graph View, Network Chart and PedigreeChart, which have their own extra requirements. Documentation is maintained on the Gramps website, and translations are handled through Hosted Weblate.
how_to_run: Read the COPYING file and the INSTALL file (for building from source)
Install Python 3.10 or greater, GTK 3.24 or greater and pygobject 3.12 or greater
Install the cairo, Pycairo, pango, pangocairo, librsvg2 and orjson packages
Optionally install osmgpsmap, Graphviz, PyICU, Ghostscript and python-imagesize as recommended
notable: Targets both casual hobbyists and professional genealogists
Optional GeoView map support via osmgpsmap
Graphviz-based reports and optional PDF creation with Ghostscript
Supports archiving family trees with GNU RCS revision control
Third-party addon ecosystem with documented prerequisites
caveats: Requires a GTK 3 desktop stack and several system packages before it runs
Several features (maps, Graphviz reports, spell checking, Exif) only work if optional packages are installed
Third-party addons are not officially part of Gramps and have their own dependencies
